description: A Flutter widget and helper class to facilitate responsiveness based on screen size. It provides breakpoints and layout adjustments for different device types like small phones and small tablets.

classes.name: ResponsiveInfo
classes.description: A helper class that provides information about the current screen size and classification (e.g., small phone, small tablet) along with computed properties like padding and typography scale.

classes.name: ResponsiveBuilder
classes.description: A stateless widget that builds UI based on current layout constraints, providing a responsive design helper to its builder function.

methods.name: ResponsiveInfo
methods.description: Constructor for the ResponsiveInfo class, requiring the screen size.

methods.name: isSmallPhone
methods.description: Indicates if the device width is less than 360 pixels.

methods.name: isPhone
methods.description: Indicates if the device width is less than 600 pixels.

methods.name: isSmallTablet
methods.description: Indicates if the device width is between 600 and 840 pixels.

methods.name: horizontalPadding
methods.description: Provides padding value based on device classification.

methods.name: typographyScale
methods.description: Provides a scaling factor for typography based on device classification.

methods.name: featuredCrossAxisCount
methods.description: Determines number of grid columns for featured items based on device size.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Overrides StatelessWidget's build method to create a widget that adapts to layout constraints using a provided builder function.
